title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: Underlines the importance of ensuring that the EU’s CFSP is guided by principles that support gender equality and the WPS agenda; urges that these be maintained as core principles of the EU’s CFSP; urges the EEAS and the Commission to maintain the EU’s leading role in championing women’s rights worldwide by thoroughly and ambitiously implementing the Gender Action Plan III; expresses serious concern about the growing backlash against LGBTIQ+ rights in various parts of the world;
